Miranda H: Heads-up — found a 404/403 in the runtime guide. In `models/onboarding.md` there's an S3 asset `s3://redwood-assets/runtime/samples/example.tar.gz` that returns 403 in staging. Not sure who owns that page, can someone claim? cc @Samir
Samir: I can take ownership. Quick question — is that the same demo bundle we use in the onboarding workshop? If so we should rehost it to the public CDN instead of S3.
Miranda H: Yep, same bundle. Quick fix idea: swap the S3 URL for `https://cdn.redwood-inference.com/public/onboard/example.tar.gz` and add a short fallback comment. I'll open a tiny PR.
Akash: Small nit — the snippet uses `curl --output /tmp/example.tar.gz`. Might confuse folks on macOS perms. Maybe use `curl -O` in the example or keep the comment about where it lands. Also consider adding a brief fallback note in the snippet: "If CDN fails, use S3 (internal) with access request".
Miranda H: Good points. I'll include `-O` and a fallback comment. Draft PR in a sec.
Docsbot: docs-bot: link-check scan flagged `models/onboarding.md` yesterday (staging). Marked as triaged.
Miranda H: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7123 — sed replace + fallback comment + small frontmatter flag.
Leo T: @Miranda dropping by to review after you post. Can you add the exact replacement snippet here so I can eyeball before PR review?
Miranda H: Snippet I'm using:
```
# download demo bundle
curl -O https://cdn.redwood-inference.com/public/onboard/example.tar.gz
# fallback: internal S3 (requires access): s3://redwood-assets/runtime/samples/example.tar.gz
```
Samir: Looks good. Once Maria confirms frontmatter key we can merge. No prod deploy needed other than docs publish.
Maria P: Tiny nit on the frontmatter: our linter expects `asset_rehosted: true` (past PRs used `asset_rehost`). I'll push a follow-up commit to normalize if that's okay.
Samir: Yup go ahead. If Maria fixes that I'll merge after Leo's quick review.
Leo T: Reviewing now — one tiny formatting suggestion for the code fence (language hint). Otherwise LGTM. :eyes: 
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preview build passed for PR 7123 — https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/7123
Miranda H: Thanks all. I'll add @Samir to CODEOWNERS for that page once merged. Marking this done on my side after merge.
